subject: satanic leaf-tailed gecko
title: This Lizard Looks Like a Rotting Leaf, Then Screams With a Red Mouth

scenes.text: Birds and snakes stare right at this lizard and see a leaf.
The satanic leaf-tailed gecko, from Madagascar, is barely three and a half inches long.
Its flat tail has notches, like a dead leaf that bugs have chewed.
Its skin has ridges like leaf veins, and it flattens itself to hide its shadow.
If a predator sees through it, it gapes wide, flashes a bright red mouth, and screams.
So the leaf a bird ignores can open up and yell at it.

description:
The satanic leaf-tailed gecko hides in plain sight as a dead, chewed-up leaf.
If a predator spots it anyway, it opens its jaws to flash a bright red mouth and lets out a loud cry.
Could you find it on a forest floor?
first_comment: It has no eyelids, so it licks its own eyeballs to keep them clean. Would you rather have eyelids or a long tongue?
